title: WISE 0855−0714 — the coldest known brown dwarf
plain_result: Too faint for most single pictures, but where it should be at 4.4–5 µm SPHEREx measures 0.50 ± 0.03 mJy in its second sky survey — the brightness Spitzer measured (0.51 mJy) — and it moved between surveys as predicted; standing still is ruled out.

numbers.label: Signal in survey 2, against 24 empty paths
Signal in survey 3 (a neighbour star restored to the model)
Chance it is a source that does not move

method_note: Position predicted from proper motion and parallax (Luhman & Esplin 2016); each picture fitted with Gaia stars; pictures at 4.4–5 µm combined per survey; significance quoted against the same path shifted to 24 empty positions. A statement about a known object, not a discovery. Survey 1 has 3 usable pictures and is not informative.
